comment: ReauthInfo stores information used for re-authentication

variables.name: mExpiryTimestampElapsedRealtime
variables.comment:
* If system elapsed time is larger than mExpiryTimestampElapsedRealtime, ReauthInfo will be
         * deleted.

methods.name: public int getReauthCount()
methods.comment:
* Retrieves reauth count for re-authentication
         *
         * @return : reauth count

methods.name: public byte[] getMk()
methods.comment:
* Retrieves Master key for re-authentication
         *
         * @return : Master Key

methods.name: public byte[] getKeyEncr()
methods.comment:
* Retrieves encryption key for re-authentication
         *
         * @return : encryption key

methods.name: public byte[] getKeyAut()
methods.comment:
* Retrieves authentication key for re-authentication
         *
         * @return : authentication key

methods.name: public boolean isValid()
methods.comment:
* Check expiration of this ReauthInfo
         *
         * @return : true(not expired)/false(expired)
